title: SALA: Semantically Aligned Latent Actions Enable Dual-Axis Scaling of Embodied Foundation Models
summary: Embodied foundation models hinge on diverse robot interaction data, which are costly to collect. Egocentric human videos offer a complementary source of experience, and latent action models (LAMs) provide a popular means of leveraging these videos for policy supervision. Compared with world-action models (WAMs), LAMs can offer greater training efficiency and potentially lower inference costs by avoiding explicit pixel prediction during policy learning and execution. However, most existing LAMs learn latent actions solely through video reconstruction, which can cause their representations to cluster by visual appearance rather than by the underlying actions. As a result, they struggle to align human actions with their robot counterparts. To bridge the gap, we introduce SALA, which emphasizes establishing the semantic correspondence for latent actions. Without requiring paired data, we use the language descriptions of unpaired human and robot clips to estimate semantic similarities and supervise cross-embodiment correspondence. Specifically, we translate these similarities into soft neighborhood structures that guide human latent actions toward semantically related robot latents, while robot action reconstruction grounds the latent space in control. The resulting shared latent action space provides a unified supervision signal for training an embodied foundation model on both human and robot videos. Notably, latent action supervision enables scaling along two axes: (1) pre-training on increasing amounts of general human video consistently reduces robot action prediction error on downstream tasks, and (2) post-training on increasing amounts of task-specific human video substantially improves real-world robot task success rates.
tldr: SALA introduces a semantically aligned latent action model that uses unpaired language descriptions to align human and robot latent actions, enabling dual-axis scaling of embodied foundation models from human videos for improved robot policy learning.
tldr_zh: SALA 提出了一种语义对齐的潜在动作模型，利用未配对的语言描述对齐人类和机器人的潜在动作，从而通过人类视频实现具身基础模型的双轴扩展，提升机器人策略学习。
summary_zh: 具身基础模型依赖于多样化的机器人交互数据，而这些数据的采集成本高昂。第一人称人类视频提供了一种补充性的经验来源，潜在动作模型（LAMs）则提供了一种利用这些视频进行策略监督的常用方法。与世界动作模型（WAMs）相比，LAMs在策略学习和执行过程中通过避免显式像素预测，能够实现更高的训练效率，并可能降低推理成本。然而，现有的大多数LAMs仅通过视频重建来学习潜在动作，这可能导致其表示按视觉外观而非潜在动作进行聚类。因此，它们难以将人类动作与对应的机器人动作对齐。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了SALA，该方法强调建立潜在动作的语义对应关系。在无需配对数据的情况下，我们利用未配对的人类和机器人视频片段的语言描述来估计语义相似性，并监督跨具身对应关系。具体而言，我们将这些相似性转化为软邻域结构，引导人类潜在动作趋向语义相关的机器人潜在动作，同时通过机器人动作重建将潜在空间扎根于控制之中。由此产生的共享潜在动作空间为在人类和机器人视频上训练具身基础模型提供了统一的监督信号。值得注意的是，潜在动作监督支持在两个维度上的扩展：（1）在不断增加数量的通用人类视频上进行预训练，持续降低下游任务中的机器人动作预测误差；（2）在不断增加数量的特定任务人类视频上进行后训练，显著提升真实世界机器人任务的成功率。

title: Reins: Frontier Multimodal Models Driving Real Robot Arms on Long-Horizon Tasks, Zero-Shot
summary: Frontier models such as GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 can now plan and call tools, yet they still struggle to drive real robots through long-horizon, contact-rich manipulation, blind while the arm moves and while they think. We present Reins, a harness in which an off-the-shelf model operates a dual-arm robot with 3D perception tools and atomic actions that report contact and grip. The model chains actions in one call, each with a condition that must hold, stopping at the first that fails; a second instance, the narrator, watches the cameras continuously and reports what changed with every result. From images, Reins also builds a simulation-ready twin of the scene for continual policy learning. With natural-language prompts and no task-specific code, GPT-6.1 Sol succeeds in 88% of real episodes on five tasks; without the harness, it fails every shell game, taking 8 times as long. Three frontier models perform alike but differ in tracking a scene that changes while the actor thinks. Code will be released upon publication.
tldr: Reins is a harness enabling frontier multimodal models to zero-shot control a dual-arm robot on long-horizon tasks using 3D perception tools, atomic actions with conditions, and a continuous narrator, achieving 88% success on real episodes.
tldr_zh: Reins 是一个框架，使前沿多模态模型能够零样本控制双臂机器人完成长时程任务，通过3D感知工具、带条件的原子动作和持续叙述者，在真实场景中达到88%成功率。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
前沿模型如GPT-6.1 Sol、GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5现已能够进行规划并调用工具，但在长时间跨度、高接触的机器人操控任务中，它们仍难以独立驱动真实机器人，特别是在机械臂运动或模型推理过程中缺乏视觉反馈的情况下。我们提出了Reins，这是一种集成框架，使现成模型能够操作双臂机器人，配备3D感知工具和可报告接触与抓取状态的原子动作。模型在单次调用中串联多个动作，每个动作都带有必须成立的条件，并在首个条件不成立时停止；另一个实例，即“叙述者”，持续监控摄像头，并针对每个结果报告所发生的变化。Reins还根据图像构建场景的仿真就绪数字孪生，用于持续策略学习。凭借自然语言提示且无需任务特定代码，GPT-6.1 Sol在五项任务中的真实场景成功率达到88%；在无该框架的情况下，它在所有“换壳游戏”任务中均失败，且耗时长达8倍。三个前沿模型表现相近，但在感知操作者思考期间场景变化的能力上存在差异。代码将在论文发表后发布。

title: STVLA: Spatial-aware and Temporal-memory forVision-Language-Action Models
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires both spatial scene understanding and task history. However, many vision-language-action (VLA) policies rely primarily on current observations, without explicitly integrating spatial structure and task history. Appearance-based memories can be sensitive to occlusion and viewpoint changes, while spatial representations of the current scene alone do not preserve how the scene has changed during task execution. We introduce STVLA, a framework that incorporates features from a pretrained visual geometry foundation model into temporal memory alongside visual representations. This allows the policy to recall past scene structure as context for current action decisions. To select informative history, STVLA uses a mathematically grounded scoring rule that balances relevance to the current observation with complementary evidence from memory. Across evaluations on LIBERO, LIBERO-Mem, MIKASA-Robo, and SimplerEnv Bridge, STVLA achieves the highest average success rate among the compared methods on each benchmark. On real-world block stacking, object organization, and phone packaging, it improves success over $π_{0.5}$ by $58.33$, $30.00$, and $35.00$ percentage points, respectively. These results support integrating scene geometry into temporal memory to improve manipulation requiring both spatial precision and task history. Project website: \href{https://stvla.github.io/}{https://stvla.github.io/}
tldr: STVLA enhances VLA policies by integrating spatial features from a geometry foundation model into temporal memory, selecting informative history via a scoring rule, improving manipulation success on benchmarks and real robots.
tldr_zh: STVLA 通过将几何基础模型的空间特征整合到时间记忆中，并利用评分规则选择信息丰富的历史，提升了操作任务的成功率。
summary_zh: 机器人操作通常需要空间场景理解和任务历史。然而，许多视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略主要依赖当前观测，未显式整合空间结构与任务历史。基于外观的记忆可能对遮挡和视角变化敏感，而仅基于当前场景的空间表示无法保留任务执行过程中场景的变化。我们提出了STVLA框架，该框架将预训练视觉几何基础模型的特征与视觉表示一同纳入时间记忆，使策略能够回忆过去的场景结构，作为当前动作决策的上下文。为选择信息量丰富的历史信息，STVLA采用一种具有数学依据的评分规则，在相关性上兼顾当前观测与记忆中的互补证据。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Mem、MIKASA-Robo和SimplerEnv Bridge上的评估中，STVLA在每个基准上的平均成功率均超过对比方法，达到最高水平。在现实世界的积木堆叠、物体整理和手机包装任务中，相较$π_{0.5}$，STVLA的成功率分别提升了58.33、30.00和35.00个百分点。这些结果支持将场景几何融入时间记忆，以提升需要空间精度与任务历史协同的操作能力。项目网站：\href{https://stvla.github.io/}{https://stvla.github.io/}

title: ActWorld-JEPA: Action-Conditioned JEPA World Models Meet Latent Planning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) enable future prediction in latent space without pixel reconstruction. However, latent predictive consistency alone does not establish the relative driving quality of candidate plans. We present ActWorld-JEPA, a joint-embedding formulation for candidate-based driving. Where Plan-Conditioned JEPA (PC-JEPA) uses global and step-wise trajectory intentions to guide recurrent latent prediction, then combines the predicted future with the current scene through gated cross-attention; Relational Residual Reranking ($R^3$) models agreement and discrepancy between plan and future representations under planning supervision, yielding bounded, gated residual corrections to the base planning scores. This formulation connects latent prediction to candidate selection using only observed context and proposed trajectories at inference. Benchmark-specific implementations report 94.1 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 navtest, with the final selector calibrated using aggregate NAVTEST feedback, and 91.6 and 42.7 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 navtest and navhard, respectively. The nuScenes evaluation reports a mean $L_2$ error of 1.20 m and a predicted collision rate of 0.76% over 1--6 s. This work provides an effective path from JEPA's predictive representations to driving decisions informed by anticipated consequences.
tldr: ActWorld-JEPA introduces a JEPA-based world model with plan-conditioned latent prediction and relational residual reranking for end-to-end autonomous driving, achieving strong results on NAVSIM and nuScenes benchmarks.
tldr_zh: ActWorld-JEPA 提出了一种基于 JEPA 的世界模型，通过条件潜在预测和关系残差重排序实现端到端自动驾驶，在 NAVSIM 和 nuScenes 基准上取得了优异结果。
summary_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）能够在潜空间中实现未来预测，而无需进行像素重构。然而，仅靠潜空间预测一致性并不足以确定候选规划方案的相对驾驶质量。我们提出了ActWorld-JEPA，一种面向基于候选方案驾驶的联合嵌入范式。其中，计划条件JEPA（PC-JEPA）利用全局和逐步轨迹意图来引导循环潜空间预测，再通过门控交叉注意力将预测的未来状态与当前场景相结合；关系残差重排序（\(R^3\)）在规划监督下对计划与未来表征之间的一致性和差异性进行建模，从而产生有界、门控的残差校正项，用于修正基础规划得分。该范式仅利用推理时观测到的上下文和提议轨迹，将潜空间预测与候选方案选择联系起来。在NAVSIM v1 navtest基准上报告了94.1的PDMS，最终选择器通过聚合NAVTEST反馈进行校准；在NAVSIM v2 navtest和navhard上分别报告了91.6和42.7的EPDMS。nuScenes评估报告了1–6秒范围内1.20米的平均\(L_2\)误差和0.76%的预测碰撞率。本工作为从JEPA的预测表征到基于预期后果的驾驶决策提供了一条有效路径。

title: FORGE: Force-Aware Multi-Granularity Control for Efficient Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinated locomotion, balance regulation, and manipulation under frequent contacts, making teleoperated demonstration collection difficult: a practical controller must simultaneously provide precision, stability, and contact awareness. We propose FORGE, a force-aware multi-granularity control system with a coarse-to-fine command space spanning velocity navigation, planar foot placement, wrist-pose tracking, and optional force-conditioning inputs. Policy training requires no full-body human motion trajectories or joint-angle references; deployment consumes only sparse bilateral wrist poses relative to the pelvis, coarse motion commands, and optional desired wrist-load inputs. For sustained contact, FORGE combines a momentum observer with a learned correction trained using simulator contact-force supervision. At deployment, it estimates low-frequency, wrist-equivalent interaction forces from proprioception and reconstructed low-level arm PD torques, without wrist force/torque sensors. A quasi-static virtual-target loop uses this estimate and an optional desired applied-force input to adapt the wrist target. A frozen locomotion prior and asymmetric residual actions stabilize manipulation-induced whole-body corrections. Experiments evaluate unified-control stability, task-space tracking, quasi-static wrist-equivalent force estimation, squeezing forces during sustained contact with a rigid box, and downstream diffusion-policy execution of a squat-and-lift task across payload conditions. Website: https://bb0928.github.io/forge/.
tldr: FORGE proposes a force-aware, multi-granularity control system for humanoid loco-manipulation that requires only sparse wrist-pose and coarse motion commands, using a momentum observer and learned correction for contact-force estimation, and a frozen locomotion prior for whole-body stability.
tldr_zh: FORGE 提出了一种力感知、多粒度的人形移动操作控制系统，仅需稀疏腕部姿态和粗略运动指令，利用动量观测器和学习校正进行接触力估计，并通过冻结的运动先验实现全身稳定性。
summary_zh: 类人形机器人全身操控需要在频繁接触下协调运动、平衡调节与操作，这使得遥操作示范数据的采集变得困难：实用的控制器必须同时具备精确性、稳定性和接触感知能力。我们提出FORGE，一种力感知的多粒度控制系统，其由粗到细的命令空间涵盖速度导航、平面足部放置、腕部姿态跟踪及可选的力调节输入。策略训练无需全身人体运动轨迹或关节角度参考；部署时仅需消耗相对于骨盆的稀疏双侧腕部姿态、粗略运动指令及可选的目标腕部负载输入。针对持续接触场景，FORGE结合动量观测器与利用仿真器接触力监督训练的学习校正模块。部署时，该系统仅通过本体感知和重构的低层手臂PD力矩估算低频、腕部等效交互力，无需腕部力/力矩传感器。准静态虚拟目标回路利用该估算值及可选的目标施加力输入来调整腕部目标。冻结的运动先验与非对称残差动作稳定了由操控引起的全身校正。实验评估了统一控制的稳定性、任务空间跟踪、准静态腕部等效力估算、与刚性箱体持续接触时的挤压力，以及跨负载条件下下蹲-抬升任务的下游扩散策略执行。网站：https://bb0928.github.io/forge/。

title: ACE-CaP-0: Real-World Code-as-Policies in the Era of Experience
summary: Recent advances in frontier models have pushed the boundaries of agentic robot control, enabling agents to perform complex robotic tasks through reasoning and interaction. However, repeated calls to these models during execution can substantially increase task completion time. Code as Policies (CaP) offers a route for coding agents to acquire physical skills through experience and retain them in executable programs, allowing the reasoning invested in development to be reused across runs. Developing reliable code policies while limiting the cost of physical experimentation remains a central challenge. We investigate human guidance as a source of priors for feasible actions and simulation as an auxiliary environment for exploring and testing candidate policies. Our findings favor robot demonstrations available on request and simulation used selectively during real-world policy refinement. These findings inform ACE-CaP-0, an agentic recipe that couples policy revision with experience acquisition through Demonstrations on Request and Simulation on Demand. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks spanning alignment, multi-object handling, and bimanual coordination, the resulting frozen programs achieve 92.1\% success (221/240 trials). Mean execution times across tasks range from 0.97 to 2.27 minutes. The programs execute with runtime perception and control, without a human or coding agent in the loop. These results highlight CaP's potential to turn experience into reliable, reusable physical skills.
tldr: This paper presents ACE-CaP-0, an agentic recipe using demonstrations on request and simulation on demand to acquire reusable code policies for real-world robotic manipulation, achieving high success rates across diverse tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出ACE-CaP-0，一种通过按需演示和按需仿真获取可重用代码策略的智能体方法，在多种真实操控任务中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 近年前沿模型的进展不断拓展智能体机器人控制的边界，使智能体能够通过推理与交互完成复杂的机器人任务。然而，在执行过程中反复调用这些模型会显著增加任务完成时间。代码即策略（Code as Policies, CaP）为编程智能体提供了一条通过经验获取物理技能，并将其保留在可执行程序中的途径，使得开发过程中投入的推理能力能够在多次运行中被复用。在限制物理实验成本的前提下开发可靠的代码策略，仍是一项核心挑战。我们研究了人类指导作为可行动作先验来源的作用，以及仿真作为探索和测试候选策略的辅助环境的潜力。研究发现，按需提供的机器人演示以及在真实世界策略精调阶段选择性使用仿真，具有较好的效果。基于这些发现，我们提出了ACE-CaP-0，一种将策略修订与经验获取相结合的智能体方案，其中经验通过按需演示（Demonstrations on Request）和按需仿真（Simulation on Demand）获得。在涵盖对齐、多物体操作和双臂协调的八项真实世界操控任务中，所生成的冻结程序取得了92.1%的成功率（221/240次试验）。各任务的平均执行时间在0.97至2.27分钟之间。这些程序在运行时完成感知与控制，无需人类或编程智能体介入循环。上述结果凸显了CaP将经验转化为可靠、可复用物理技能的潜力。

title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
summary: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. EgoX pretrains a Modularized Cross-Embodiment Transformer with Embodiment Dreaming (MXT+) on this mixture and fine-tunes it on target-embodiment demonstrations. Within each embodiment, MXT+ assigns a dedicated tokenizer to each observation modality and a dedicated expert to each action modality, with a Transformer trunk shared across embodiments. A training-only embodiment-dreaming objective predicts latent representations of future visual and proprioceptive states, encouraging the shared trunk to model each embodiment's dynamics. Across 13 task-embodiment pairs spanning five tasks and six robot embodiments, including five physical robots and one simulated humanoid, cross-embodiment pretraining raises MXT+'s average normalized task progress from 0.63 to 0.80 over training from scratch. The gains are particularly pronounced under out-of-distribution conditions, where average task progress increases from 0.53 to 0.77. Ablations demonstrate the benefits of broader pretraining mixtures, modular interfaces, and embodiment dreaming, with dreaming producing more similar latent geometry across embodiments. Project page: egox-dream.github.io.
tldr: EgoX introduces a cross-embodiment learning framework that pretrains a modularized transformer with an embodiment-dreaming objective on heterogeneous demonstrations, improving manipulation policy performance across five physical robots and one simulated humanoid.
tldr_zh: EgoX 提出了一种跨实体学习框架，通过模块化变换器和实体梦境目标在异构演示上进行预训练，提升了多种机器人操作策略的性能。
summary_zh: 通用型操作策略可以从人类、真实机器人和模拟智能体的互补经验中获益。然而，形态、感知和控制接口的差异使得从它们的组合演示中有效学习变得困难。我们引入EgoX，一种以自我为中心、跨具身的学习框架，通过语义对应的观察和动作模态来组织异构演示。EgoX在混合数据上预训练一个模块化跨具身Transformer，并配备具身梦境机制（MXT+），然后在目标具身演示上进行微调。在每个具身内部，MXT+为每种观察模态分配专门的标记器，为每种动作模态分配专门的专家模块，同时共享跨具身的Transformer主干。一个仅用于训练阶段的具身梦境目标用于预测未来视觉和本体感觉状态的潜在表示，鼓励共享主干建模每个具身的动力学。在跨越五个任务和六个机器人具身的13个任务-具身组合中（包括五个实体机器人和一个模拟人形机器人），跨具身预训练将MXT+的平均归一化任务进度从从零训练的0.63提升到0.80。在分布外条件下，这一提升尤为显著，平均任务进度从0.53提升到0.77。消融实验证明了更广泛的预训练混合、模块化接口和具身梦境机制的益处，其中梦境机制使不同具身间的潜在几何结构更加相似。项目主页：egox-dream.github.io。

title: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
summary: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native and fragment-level goal attainment, compared with 71.03\% for INTACT, 61.66\% for PRISM, and 58.66\% for LeWM. Component interventions and expert-relative action-structure comparisons support demonstration-informed continuations and reveal task-dependent effects of visual conditioning, history length, and planning horizon.
tldr: This paper introduces LG-DKGP, a novel continuity-aware prior for world-model planning that learns action continuations from expert demonstrations, improving planning success in five simulated embodied tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出LG-DKGP，一种用于世界模型规划的连续性感知先验，通过从专家演示中学习动作延续来提升五个仿真具身任务的规划成功率。
summary_zh: 专家演示中的动作具有时间结构。对五个环境进行有序与乱序对比分析，证实了这种依赖性。我们探究，若动作提议能更好地反映专家连续性，是否可提升视觉世界模型规划的性能。我们并非施加通用的平滑性约束，而是从演示动作的时间结构中学习延续模式。我们提出的局部门控深核高斯过程先验（LG-DKGP）融合了近期及较长时间范围内的已执行动作历史，预测神经延续，并学习时间高斯过程（GP）残差。由训练导出的探索尺度在修正均值附近初始化搜索；冻结的世界模型评估朝向目标的进展。训练首先拟合神经均值，随后利用专家未来动作联合优化先验与GP残差。所构建的规划器在涵盖原生与片段级目标达成的五个模拟任务中实现87.07%的宏观成功率，而INTACT、PRISM和LeWM分别为71.03%、61.66%和58.66%。组件干预及与专家相对的动作结构比较证实了基于演示信息的延续的有效性，并揭示了视觉条件、历史长度和规划范围的任务依赖性影响。

title: HALO: Human-Aligned Data Collection for WhoLe-body MObile Manipulation
summary: Learning whole-body mobile manipulation requires demonstrations that coordinate bimanual actions with locomotion across extended workspaces. However, existing interfaces trade off direct robot control, perception and action alignment, and natural operator mobility, making such demonstrations difficult to collect. We introduce HALO, a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation. The system aligns the operator's perception and action space with the robot while preserving direct physical feedback and natural locomotion. Operators guide the robot end-effectors through kinesthetic teaching and move a low-resistance platform without the deployed mobile base while performing bimanual manipulation. This interface enables more natural whole-body demonstrations, but the close human-robot coupling introduces discrepancies between the demonstration and deployment settings. We address these discrepancies with deployment-aligned demonstration processing, which calibrates and temporally aligns platform motion with the deployed base response and masks and inpaints demonstrator hands in recorded observations. Compared with Mobile ALOHA and VR teleoperation, HALO enables up to 2.9x faster demonstration collection while maintaining comparable or higher success rates. Policies trained with HALO perform precise manipulation tasks, including zip-tie fastening, and achieve a 73.3% success rate on a six-stage long-horizon mobile manipulation task involving repeated coordinated base and arm motion. Project page: https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/
tldr: HALO introduces a human-aligned data collection system for whole-body mobile manipulation, using kinesthetic teaching and a low-resistance platform to collect demonstrations faster and more naturally than existing teleoperation methods, with deployment-aligned processing that improves policy success on long-horizon tasks.
tldr_zh: HALO提出了一种用于全身移动操作的人机对齐数据采集系统，通过触觉示教和低阻力平台实现更快速、更自然的演示采集，并通过部署对齐处理提高长时程任务策略的成功率。
summary_zh: 学习全身移动操作需要能够协调双臂动作与跨越扩展工作空间的移动的示范。然而，现有接口在直接机器人控制、感知与动作对齐以及操作者自然移动性之间存在权衡，使得此类示范难以采集。我们提出了HALO，一种用于全身移动操作的人对齐数据采集系统。该系统在保持直接物理反馈和自然移动的同时，将操作者的感知和动作空间与机器人对齐。操作者通过触觉引导方式操控机器人末端执行器，并在执行双臂操作时移动一个未搭载移动底盘的低阻力平台。该接口能够实现更自然的全身示范，但密切的人机耦合引入了示范场景与部署场景之间的差异。我们通过部署对齐的示范处理来解决这些差异，该方法对平台运动进行标定并使其与部署底座的响应在时间上对齐，同时对记录观测中的操作者手部进行掩码和修复。与Mobile ALOHA和VR遥操作相比，HALO实现了最高2.9倍的示范采集速度提升，同时保持了相当或更高的成功率。使用HALO训练的策略能够执行精细操作任务，包括扎带紧固，并在一个涉及反复协调底座与手臂运动的六阶段长时程移动操作任务中达到73.3%的成功率。项目主页：https://robbyant-research.github.io/Lingbot-ALOHA/

title: BlinkMimic: Training a Humanoid Motion Tracker in Minutes on a Single GPU
summary: Whole-body motion tracking lets a humanoid robot follow reference motions, but training a tracking policy for a library of motions has usually taken hours of GPU time. SuperMimic showed that the policy can instead be trained by backpropagating through a world model learned from parallel simulation, and InstantTrack added Muon updates, a residual policy around the reference and an averaged deployed policy. We build on both and present BlinkMimic, a recipe that makes this training faster. On a simulated Unitree G1, BlinkMimic trains one policy for all 40 LAFAN1 clips in 3.4 minutes on a single RTX 4090, measured until three consecutive checkpoints reach a normalized return of at least 0.82 with no failed clip (mean of three seeds). We split training time into the cost of an iteration, the iterations needed to fit the motions, and the iterations needed to remove the last failures, and assign each component, inherited or new, to one of these terms. The new components are a step size that decreases once training has progressed, resets directed by failures of the deployed policy under deployment conditions, and GPU graph capture of the whole iteration. A leave-one-out ablation with three seeds per component shows which term each component affects, and further measurements of the gradient, the update rule and the failure cases explain these effects. Code and per-seed results are available at https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic.
tldr: BlinkMimic accelerates whole-body humanoid motion tracking policy training to 3.4 minutes for 40 motions on a single GPU by combining step-size decay, failure-directed resets, and GPU graph capture, building on SuperMimic and InstantTrack.
tldr_zh: BlinkMimic 通过结合步长衰减、失败导向的重置和 GPU 图捕获，将全身人形运动跟踪策略的训练加速到单 GPU 上 3.4 分钟完成 40 个动作，基于 SuperMimic 和 InstantTrack。
summary_zh: 全身运动跟踪使仿人机器人能够跟随参考运动，但为运动库训练跟踪策略通常需要数小时的GPU时间。SuperMimic表明，可以通过从并行仿真中学习到的世界模型进行反向传播来训练策略，而InstantTrack则增加了Muon更新、围绕参考的残差策略以及平均部署策略。我们在两者的基础上提出了BlinkMimic，这是一种使训练更快的方案。在模拟的Unitree G1上，BlinkMimic在单个RTX 4090上仅用3.4分钟即为全部40个LAFAN1片段训练出一个策略，测量标准为连续三个检查点达到归一化回报至少0.82且无失败片段（三个种子的平均值）。我们将训练时间分解为迭代成本、拟合运动所需的迭代次数以及消除最后失败所需的迭代次数，并将每个组件（继承的或新增的）归入其中一项。新增组件包括：训练进展后递减的步长、由部署条件下部署策略的失败引导的重置，以及整个迭代的GPU图捕获。对每个组件进行三个种子的留一法消融实验，展示了每个组件影响的项，进一步的梯度、更新规则和失败案例测量解释了这些影响。代码及每个种子的结果可在 https://github.com/fuyichen0725/blinkmimic 获取。

title: I See What You Want: Decoding Hierarchical Operator Intent from Visual Teleoperation History
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have become a powerful foundation for robotic scene understanding, task planning, and language-conditioned control. A natural question follows: can these models also decode what a human operator intends while teleoperating a robot, without any explicit instruction? We formulate this as hierarchical intent prediction, jointly inferring the ongoing atomic action and the broader mission it serves from a short visual teleoperation history. To study this, we introduce VI AMO (Vision Intention Action and Mission Ongoing), a dataset of 6,600 episodes from eleven robot sources with 13,653 temporally aligned action annotations and 9,702 mission annotations. Large proprietary models struggle with this problem: on held-out episodes, GPT-4o reaches Sentence-BERT similarities of only 0.563 and 0.470 for action and mission, and GPT-5.6 Luna achieves only 0.581 and 0.554. Fine-tuning a VLM on VI AMO yields our Vision-Intention Model (VIM), which raises these scores to 0.825 and 0.821 and still reaches 0.726 and 0.717 on the 35.4% of test actions with both labels absent from training. Finally, as a downstream application, VIM's predicted mission enables a vision-language-action (VLA) policy to take over from the operator mid-task in a real-world environment unseen during VIM fine-tuning, reducing human teleoperation time by 34.6% relative to GPT-4o and 39.8% relative to GPT-5.6 Luna, while cutting intent-prediction latency by roughly 70% on average.
tldr: This paper introduces VI AMO, a large-scale dataset for hierarchical operator intent prediction from visual teleoperation history, and presents VIM, a fine-tuned VLM that decodes both ongoing actions and missions. VIM's predicted mission is shown to enable a VLA policy to take over mid-task, reducing teleoperation time, demonstrating a concrete robotic downstream application.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了VI AMO，一个大规模分层操作者意图预测数据集，并提出了VIM，一个微调的VLM，可解码正在进行的动作和任务。VIM的预测任务使VLA策略能够在任务中途接管，减少遥操作时间，展示了具体的机器人下游应用。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLMs）已成为机器人场景理解、任务规划和基于语言的控制的有力基础。随之而来的一个自然问题是：这些模型能否在没有明确指令的情况下，解读操作员在遥控操作机器人时的意图？我们将此定义为一个分层意图预测问题，即从短段的视觉遥操作历史中，联合推断正在进行的原子动作及其所服务的更广泛任务。为研究此问题，我们引入了VI AMO（视觉意图、动作与进行中任务）数据集，该数据集包含来自11个机器人来源的6,600条片段，配有13,653条时间对齐的动作标注和9,702条任务标注。大型专有模型在此问题上表现不佳：在保留片段上，GPT-4o在动作和任务上的Sentence-BERT相似度仅达到0.563和0.470，而GPT-5.6 Luna仅达到0.581和0.554。在VI AMO上微调VLM得到我们的视觉意图模型（VIM），将这些分数提升至0.825和0.821，并且在训练中未出现两种标签的35.4%测试动作上，仍然达到0.726和0.717。最后，作为下游应用，VIM预测的任务使视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略能够在VIM微调过程中未见过的真实环境中，从操作员手中中途接管任务，相比于GPT-4o，人类遥操作时间减少了34.6%，相比于GPT-5.6 Luna减少了39.8%，同时意图预测延迟平均降低了约70%。

title: Remember What Changes the Odds: Critic-Gated Event Memory for Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: In long-horizon manipulation, a robot may need to take different actions under identical observations, depending on task progress and the outcomes of earlier attempts. We refer to this ambiguity as decision aliasing. Resolving it requires the policy to maintain memory of its execution history. To reduce the cost of processing full observation histories, recent methods build compact event memories using perceptual, semantic, or kinematic cues. However, these criteria may miss events that matter for task success. We instead propose an outcome-grounded principle: remember events that substantially change the predicted probability of eventual success. Following this principle, we introduce CGEM, a critic-gated event memory that uses a critic to select events with large estimated changes in success probability. Positive and negative changes are encoded as progress and failure records, respectively. Failure records are discarded once the corresponding subtask is completed. In a ten-subtask diagnostic environment with exactly computed success probabilities, CGEM achieves 88.0% success, compared with 0.0% for both a 36-step observation window and a kinematic event memory. Removing failure records reduces success to 1.7%.
tldr: The paper proposes CGEM, a critic-gated event memory that selects events based on changes in predicted success probability to resolve decision aliasing in long-horizon manipulation, achieving high success in a diagnostic environment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出CGEM，一种基于评论家门控的事件记忆机制，根据预测成功概率的变化选择事件，以解决长时程操作中的决策混淆问题，在诊断环境中取得了高成功率。
summary_zh: 在长时程操作任务中，机器人可能在相同观测下需要采取不同动作，这取决于任务进度及早期尝试的结果。我们将这种歧义称为决策混淆。解决该问题要求策略保持对执行历史的记忆。为降低处理完整观测历史的成本，近期方法利用感知、语义或运动学线索构建紧凑的事件记忆。然而，这些标准可能遗漏对任务成功至关重要的关键事件。为此，我们提出一种基于结果导向的原则：记忆那些能显著改变最终成功预测概率的事件。遵循该原则，我们引入CGEM——一种评论家门控事件记忆机制，利用评论家筛选出估计成功概率变化较大的事件。正向与负向变化分别编码为进度记录与失败记录。失败记录在相应子任务完成后即被丢弃。在包含十个子任务且成功概率可精确计算的诊断环境中，CGEM实现了88.0%的成功率，而采用36步观测窗口和运动学事件记忆的方法成功率均为0.0%。移除失败记录后，成功率降至1.7%。

title: ManiLadder: Benchmarking Robot Manipulation Through a Categorized and Multi-Difficulty Level Task Ladder
summary: Recent advances in robotic manipulation have enabled increasingly complex and dexterous behaviors, yet existing benchmarks still focus on simple pick-and-place tasks and lack a systematic framework for measuring progress in robot learning along the axis of task difficulty. We present ManiLadder, a large-scale and organized simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation. ManiLadder contains 112 carefully designed tasks stratified into 4 difficulty levels, with 8 categories in each level, spanning rigid-body and deformable-object manipulation, single-arm and dual-arm settings, and gripper and dexterous-hand end-effectors. To calibrate difficulty, we fix the data amount the same for every task and use a unified flow- matching imitation learning policy under the same training and evaluation protocols, then use its evaluation success rate as an operational empirical difficulty signal. All tasks are iteratively refined until they fall into target difficulty ranges, which are then verified across different random seeds, policies, and agentic learning systems. We further analyze the task properties, compare different policy performances and training settings, analyze task transfer and data scaling behaviors, and conduct real-world experiments showing that the designed tasks preserve their difficulty ordering beyond simulation. ManiLad- der provides a calibrated ladder for measuring, comparing, and advancing robotic manipulation capabilities. More results are available at https://maniladder-benchmark.github.io/.
tldr: ManiLadder is a large-scale simulation benchmark for robotic manipulation with 112 tasks across 4 difficulty levels, calibrated using a unified imitation learning policy and verified across seeds, policies, and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: ManiLadder 是一个大规模机器人操作模拟基准，包含112个任务，分4个难度级别，通过统一模仿学习策略进行校准，并在不同种子、策略和真实世界中验证。
summary_zh: 近期在机器人操作领域的进展已实现日益复杂和灵巧的行为，然而现有基准测试仍集中于简单的抓取与放置任务，缺乏系统框架来衡量机器人学习在任务难度维度上的进展。我们提出了ManiLadder，一个大规模、有组织的机器人操作仿真基准测试平台。ManiLadder包含112个精心设计的任务，分为4个难度等级，每个等级涵盖8个类别，涉及刚体和可变形物体操作、单臂与双臂设置，以及夹爪和灵巧手末端执行器。为校准难度，我们为每个任务设定相同的数据量，并在统一的训练与评估协议下使用统一的流匹配模仿学习策略，然后将其评估成功率作为经验性难度信号。所有任务均经过迭代优化，直至落入目标难度范围，并通过不同随机种子、策略和智能体学习系统进行验证。我们进一步分析了任务属性，比较了不同策略性能和训练设置，分析了任务迁移和数据扩展行为，并进行了真实世界实验，表明所设计的任务在仿真之外仍保持其难度排序。ManiLadder为衡量、比较和推进机器人操作能力提供了一个校准的阶梯。更多结果请访问https://maniladder-benchmark.github.io/。

title: MotionSkill: From Bipedal Motion Video to Control across Embodiments
summary: Reusing a demonstrated gait can reduce the work of specifying the same motion for each biped. A video captures the timing of a step, but each robot must execute it with its own limbs and actuators. MotionSkill recovers a timed reference once from monocular video and adapts it to each target in simulation. It aligns root motion and body landmarks in a common frame and records which landmarks are available at each instant. At each source timestamp, the mapper preserves limb directions, uses the target segment lengths, and solves inverse kinematics under joint limits and closure constraints. In MuJoCo, we train a separate residual policy for each of ten bipeds on its mapped reference from one four-second walking clip. Each policy uses the measured robot state to correct joint commands during contact. From initial states held out during training, MotionSkill completed 98% of trials on the original video and 26% with the upper body occluded for one second.
tldr: MotionSkill extracts a timed gait reference from monocular bipedal walking video and maps it across different embodied bipedal robots, then trains residual policies in simulation to track it successfully from held-out initial states.
tldr_zh: MotionSkill 从单目双足行走视频中提取带时间步态的参考，并将其映射到不同双足机器人上，然后在仿真中训练残差策略以跟踪该参考。
summary_zh: 重用已演示的步态可以减少为每个双足机器人指定相同运动所需的工作量。视频捕捉步态的时间节点，但每个机器人必须用自身的肢体和执行器来执行该运动。MotionSkill 从单目视频中仅恢复一次带时间参照，并在仿真中将其适配到每个目标。它在统一坐标系中对齐根运动和身体关键点，并记录每个时刻可用的关键点。在每个源时间戳上，映射器保留肢体方向，使用目标肢体段长度，并在关节限位和闭合约束下求解逆运动学。在 MuJoCo 中，我们基于一个四秒行走片段映射的参考轨迹，为十个双足机器人分别训练独立的残差策略。每个策略使用实测的机器人状态在接触过程中修正关节指令。从训练过程中未出现的初始状态出发，MotionSkill 在原始视频中完成了 98% 的试验，在上半身被遮挡一秒的情况下完成了 26% 的试验。

title: Alloy: A Multi-Material Physics Engine for Robot Learning
summary: Robots handle much more than rigid objects: towels, cables, water, sand. The simulators used to train robots at scale are strongest on rigid bodies, and adding another material usually means a second engine and hand-written glue between the two. We present Alloy, an open-source physics engine for robot learning in which rigid robots, cloth, cables, liquids, granular material and soft bodies share one scene. Each object is described once; Alloy assigns it to a solver suited to its material, couples the solvers inside every control step, and runs the scene in many parallel worlds on one GPU, or on a CPU. Every world carries a health grade, to help tell a failure of the physics from a failure of the policy. Alloy is built on Newton, MuJoCo Warp and Warp, and it is written to be driven by coding agents: its documentation ships inside the package, every error names its fix, and the engine is exposed as tools over the Model Context Protocol. In a cold test, agents that had never seen Alloy installed a pre-release from the package index and trained policies for walking, cable handling and pouring on a single GPU. We also report how throughput grows with the number of worlds, depth-camera throughput, agreement with closed-form references, and a reliability test over a thousand worlds.
tldr: Alloy is an open-source multi-material physics engine for robot learning, supporting rigid objects, cloth, cables, liquids, granular materials, and soft bodies in a single scene, with GPU parallelization and tools for coding agents.
tldr_zh: Alloy 是一个面向机器人学习的开源多材料物理引擎，可在同一场景中支持刚体、布料、线缆、液体、颗粒材料和软体，并具备 GPU 并行化和面向编码代理的工具。
summary_zh: 机器人处理的远不止刚体：毛巾、线缆、水、沙子。用于大规模训练机器人的模拟器在刚体方面最为强大，而添加另一种材料通常意味着需要第二个引擎，并在两者之间手写胶合代码。我们提出Alloy，一个用于机器人学习的开源物理引擎，其中刚体机器人、布料、线缆、液体、颗粒材料和软体共享同一场景。每个对象只描述一次；Alloy将其分配给适合其材料的求解器，在每个控制步骤内耦合各求解器，并在一个GPU或多个CPU上并行运行多个世界的场景。每个世界都带有健康评级，以帮助区分物理失败与策略失败。Alloy基于Newton、MuJoCo Warp和Warp构建，专为编码代理驱动而编写：其文档随包发布，每条错误信息都指出相应修复方案，引擎通过模型上下文协议以工具形式暴露。在冷测试中，从未见过Alloy的代理从包索引安装了预发布版本，并在单个GPU上训练了行走、线缆处理和倒水策略。我们还报告了吞吐量随世界数量增长的情况、深度相机吞吐量、与闭式参考解的一致性，以及跨越一千个世界的可靠性测试。

title: What Can a VLA Learn from the Agent That Calls It? Task-Level Experience Distillation for Embodied Navigation
summary: Navigation agents use a large language model (LLM) planner to call a vision-language-action (VLA) model. Each episode needs the LLM, adding cost and delay. We distill successful agent experience into the VLA instead of distilling the planner. The VLA then navigates alone at test time. Agent sessions are not VLA demonstrations. They include motions driven by planner tools and sub-instructions, along with detours. We present H2E, a task-level experience distillation method that converts these sessions into VLA training data. Every motion becomes a VLA action under the original task instruction, with the resulting poses as targets. H2E masks the loss on steps that move away from the goal. It labels every visited state within 1 m of the goal as a stop. We then update the VLA with low-rank adaptation. The VLA learns to stop at the goal and find goals the base model never reaches. On all 3,189 REVERIE-CE val-unseen episodes, H2E raises the success rate of an 8B VLA from 35.0% to 44.9%.
tldr: H2E distills task-level agent experience (from an LLM planner calling a VLA) into the VLA itself, enabling it to navigate alone and improving success rate on REVERIE-CE from 35.0% to 44.9%.
tldr_zh: H2E 将任务级代理经验（由 LLM 规划器调用 VLA 时产生）蒸馏到 VLA 中，使其能够独立导航，并在 REVERIE-CE 上成功率从 35.0% 提升至 44.9%。
summary_zh: 导航代理利用大型语言模型（LLM）规划器来调用视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。每个回合都需要LLM的参与，这增加了成本和延迟。我们不是将规划器进行蒸馏，而是将成功的代理经验蒸馏进VLA中。这样，在测试时，VLA便能独立进行导航。代理会话并非VLA的演示数据，它们包含由规划器工具和子指令驱动的动作，以及绕路行为。我们提出了H2E，一种任务级经验蒸馏方法，将这些会话转化为VLA训练数据。在原始任务指令下，每个动作都成为VLA的一个动作，并将产生的姿态作为目标。H2E对偏离目标的步骤的损失进行掩码处理，并将目标1米范围内的所有已访问状态标记为停止状态。随后，我们使用低秩适配对VLA进行更新。VLA学会了在目标处停止，并能找到基础模型从未到达的目标。在全部3,189个REVERIE-CE验证集未见过的回合中，H2E将8B参数VLA的成功率从35.0%提升至44.9%。

title: Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning with Task-Centric Perception
summary: Long-horizon manipulation under uncertainty remains a challenging problem in robotics. We present \ourmethod{}, an algorithm for Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning. \ourmethod{} extends existing deterministic task and motion planning solvers to partially observable object rearrangement tasks, while still being able to take advantage of the efficiency and compositional generalization over long horizons of the base solver. This extension interleaves sensing actions into a plan skeleton that assumed full observability, and uses a novel persistent object-based memory to fuse observations into object mesh hypotheses and an observed occupancy map. We evaluate \ourmethod{} on real-world tabletop rearrangement tasks which feature heavy occlusion and partial visibility and demonstrate that it outperforms baselines that do not perform active perception or have persistent memory.
tldr: This paper presents a Visibility-Aware Task and Motion Planning algorithm that extends deterministic TAMP solvers to partially observable object rearrangement tasks by interleaving sensing actions and using persistent object-based memory, demonstrating improved performance on real-world tabletop rearrangement tasks with heavy occlusion.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种可见性感知的任务与运动规划算法，将确定性TAMP求解器扩展到部分可观察的物体重排任务，通过插入感知动作和使用持久化物体记忆，在严重遮挡的真实桌面重排任务中取得了优于基线的方法。
summary_zh: 不确定性条件下的长时域操控仍是机器人学中的一项挑战性难题。我们提出\ourmethod{}，一种用于可见性感知任务与运动规划的算法。\ourmethod{}将现有的确定性任务与运动规划求解器扩展至部分可观测的物体重排任务，同时仍能利用基础求解器在长时域上的高效性与组合泛化能力。该扩展在原本假设完全可观测的规划骨架中交织插入感知动作，并采用一种新颖的基于对象的持久化记忆，将观测结果融合为物体网格假设及观测占据图。我们在具有严重遮挡和部分可见性的真实桌面重排任务上对\ourmethod{}进行了评估，并证明其性能优于未进行主动感知或不具备持久化记忆的基线方法。

title: PERA: Plug-in Experts for Robotic Actions in Continual Whole-Body Control
summary: Motion imitation enables humanoid robots to acquire whole-body skills such as walking and dancing. However, fine-tuning an entire policy for a new skill can affect existing behaviors, while training a separate policy for each skill increases training and maintenance costs. We present PERA, a method for learning new skills by reusing existing motion capabilities. PERA freezes a pretrained mixture-of-experts policy and trains an additional task expert and its routing score using task rewards or teacher-action supervision. In Unitree G1 simulation, each added task module contains approximately 1.03% of the parameters of the base actor. Built on our pretrained policy, PERA successfully completes all ten new tasks. Disabling the expert restores the original computation path of the base policy, which still fully executes all 126 original motions. Enabling the expert also improves the execution of some dance motions not used to train that expert, indicating that its benefits extend beyond its training motions. Experiments with HoloMotion further demonstrate the applicability of PERA to different base policies.
tldr: PERA introduces a plug-in expert method for continual whole-body control of humanoid robots, freezing a pretrained mixture-of-experts policy and adding lightweight task-specific experts to learn new skills without degrading existing behaviors.
tldr_zh: PERA 提出了一种用于人形机器人全身持续控制的即插即用专家方法，冻结预训练的专家混合策略，并添加轻量级任务专用专家以学习新技能，且不损害已有行为。
summary_zh: 运动模仿使仿人机器人能够习得行走、跳舞等全身技能。然而，为一项新技能对整个策略进行微调可能会影响已有行为，而针对每项技能分别训练独立策略则会增加训练与维护成本。我们提出PERA，一种通过复用现有运动能力来学习新技能的方法。PERA冻结预训练的专家混合策略，仅训练额外的任务专家及其路由分数，利用任务奖励或教师动作监督进行优化。在宇树G1仿真中，每个新增任务模块的参数量约为基础actor的1.03%。基于我们的预训练策略，PERA成功完成了全部十项新任务。禁用该专家后，可恢复基础策略的原始计算路径，仍能完整执行全部126个原有动作。启用该专家还能改善部分未用于训练该专家的舞蹈动作的执行效果，表明其益处超越了训练动作本身。基于HoloMotion的实验进一步验证了PERA适用于不同的基础策略。

title: JustRUA: A Controlled Study of GPT-6 Robot-Use Agents
summary: GPT-6 Astra can drive a robot arm directly through a fixed harness, and scores of such robot-use agents on RoboDojo have risen quickly since. Reported systems differ in harness and test subset and often change several designs at once, so it is hard to tell which choices produce the gains. We take these designs apart and test them in one framework, along the harness around the model, the action interface, the reuse of experience and the scene geometry given to the model. A lean harness that keeps the full episode history and stops each motion early goes a long way. Reusing experience changes how the model acts but is not a free lunch, and scene geometry helps most, even when depth is predicted from RGB alone. JustRUA starts from the official L3 harness and keeps only what matters most. Even with no learned policy, self-improvement loop or task-specific tuning, this simple harness raises the score on the RoboDojo simulation benchmark substantially, from 29.7 to 50.3.
tldr: This paper presents a controlled study of GPT-6 robot-use agents on the RoboDojo benchmark, isolating the effects of harness design, action interface, experience reuse, and scene geometry. The resulting lean harness, JustRUA, significantly improves the simulation score from 29.7 to 50.3 without learned policies or task-specific tuning.
tldr_zh: 本文对RoboDojo基准上的GPT-6机器人使用智能体进行了受控研究，分离了框架设计、动作接口、经验复用和场景几何的影响。由此产生的精简框架JustRUA无需学习策略或任务特定调优，即将模拟得分从29.7提升至50.3。
summary_zh: GPT-6 Astra可以通过固定线束直接驱动机械臂，此后，在RoboDojo平台上，此类机器人操作代理的得分迅速攀升。现有系统在线束配置和测试子集上各不相同，且常常同时改变多个设计要素，因此难以辨别究竟是哪些选择带来了性能提升。我们拆解了这些设计，并在统一框架下进行测试，涉及围绕模型的线束配置、动作接口、经验复用以及提供给模型的场景几何信息。一个精简的线束配置，保留完整的历史轨迹并提前终止每个动作，能带来显著效果。经验复用会改变模型的行为方式，但并非无偿的免费午餐；而场景几何信息带来的收益最大，即便深度信息仅从RGB图像中预测而来。JustRUA以官方L3线束为基础，仅保留最关键的部分。即便没有学习策略、自我改进循环或任务特定调优，这一精简线束也能大幅提升RoboDojo仿真基准的得分，从29.7升至50.3。

title: DexRemo: A Force-Sensing Hand Platform and Task Suite for Contact-Rich Removal Manipulation
summary: Many manipulation tasks require separating adhered, embedded, contaminated, or mechanically constrained targets. We study this setting as removal manipulation, where progress depends on evolving contact states that are only partially observable from vision and kinematics. We introduce DexRemo, a three-finger robotic hand with high-force actuation, modular fingertips, and three-axis fingertip force sensing, together with a nine-scenario real-robot task suite spanning adhesive detachment, surface cleaning and self-cleaning, and occluded retrieval. To make multi-finger force observations easier to fuse, we express fingertip forces in a shared wrist-centered frame, giving force components consistent geometric meaning across fingers and time. Using an Action Chunking Transformer backbone, policies fuse multi-view vision, proprioception, fingertip pose, and force observations to predict closed-loop action chunks from demonstrations. Evaluation uses six core benchmark tasks for controlled fingertip-input and force-frame ablations, plus three extension scenarios for additional held-out coverage. Across these evaluations, the learned policies achieve consistent removal performance, and ablations show that wrist-frame forces, especially with fingertip pose, improve stability and generalization over local-frame force inputs and no-force baselines. Project website: https://dexremo.github.io
tldr: DexRemo introduces a three-finger force-sensing robotic hand and a nine-scenario task suite for contact-rich removal manipulation, demonstrating that shared wrist-frame force observations improve the stability and generalization of Action Chunking Transformer policies on real robots.
tldr_zh: DexRemo 提出了一种三指力传感机械手和包含九个场景的接触丰富移除操作任务套件，并通过实验表明共享腕部坐标系下的力观测能够提高 Action Chunking Transformer 策略在真实机器人上的稳定性和泛化能力。
summary_zh: 许多操作任务要求分离粘附、嵌入、受污染或机械约束的目标。我们将这一场景研究为移除操作，其进展依赖于仅能从视觉和运动学中部分观测到的接触状态演变。我们提出了DexRemo，一种具有高力驱动、模块化指尖和三轴指尖力传感的三指机器人手，并配套一个涵盖粘附分离、表面清洁与自清洁以及遮挡取回的九场景真实机器人任务套件。为使多指力观测更易于融合，我们将指尖力表达在共享的以手腕为中心的坐标系中，使力分量在手指间和时间上具有一致的几何意义。基于Action Chunking Transformer骨干网络，策略融合多视角视觉、本体感觉、指尖位姿和力观测，从示范中预测闭环动作块。评估使用六项核心基准任务进行受控的指尖输入和力坐标系消融实验，另加三个扩展场景以覆盖额外的留出情况。在这些评估中，学习到的策略实现了稳定的移除性能，消融实验表明，手腕坐标系下的力，尤其是结合指尖位姿时，相较于局部坐标系力输入和无力基线，提升了稳定性和泛化能力。项目网站：https://dexremo.github.io

title: Video-Action Models for Data-Efficient Industrial Manipulation
summary: Industrial manipulation requires precise alignment and controlled handling of rigid, deformable, and flexible components. Yet, the benefits of pretrained visuomotor policies remain underexplored in settings where limited access to specialized hardware, components, and fixtures constrains demonstration collection and evaluation. Understanding task-specific data requirements is important for assessing their scalability across diverse processes on the factory floor. We investigate whether video pretraining can support reliable industrial manipulation with limited action data. We propose FLUX-mimic, a video-action model, motivated by the potential of video pretraining to capture motion and interaction patterns that enable sample-efficient training. FLUX-mimic is built on a backbone pretrained on large-scale web and industrial task data, and an action expert to generate robot trajectories. We train our policy by joint video-action training. Across four automotive manufacturing benchmark tasks and two bimanual robot platforms, FLUX-mimic outperforms all considered baselines on the dexterous robot platform and matches pi_{0.5}'s average success rate on the gripper-based robot platform. On a deformable part kitting task, FLUX-mimic reaches 77.5% success with as little as two hours of task-specific action-labeled demonstrations.
tldr: The paper proposes FLUX-mimic, a video-action model for industrial manipulation that leverages video pretraining and joint video-action training to achieve sample-efficient learning, outperforming baselines on automotive tasks with limited action data.
tldr_zh: 本文提出FLUX-mimic，一种用于工业操作视频-动作模型，通过视频预训练和联合视频-动作训练在有限动作数据下实现高效学习，在汽车制造任务上超越基线。
summary_zh: 工业操控要求对刚性、可变形及柔性部件进行精确对准与受控处理。然而，在专用硬件、部件和夹具获取受限从而制约演示采集与评估的场景中，预训练视觉运动策略的优势仍未得到充分探索。理解任务特定的数据需求，对于评估这些策略在工厂车间多样化流程中的可扩展性至关重要。我们研究视频预训练是否能在有限的动作数据条件下支持可靠的工业操控。受视频预训练捕捉运动与交互模式、从而助力样本高效训练的潜力启发，我们提出视频-动作模型FLUX-mimic。FLUX-mimic基于在大规模网络及工业任务数据上预训练的主干网络构建，并配备动作专家模块以生成机器人轨迹。我们通过视频-动作联合训练来训练该策略。在四个汽车制造基准任务和两个双臂机器人平台上，FLUX-mimic在灵巧机器人平台上优于所有考虑的基线方法，并在基于夹爪的机器人平台上与pi_{0.5}的平均成功率持平。在可变形部件装配任务中，FLUX-mimic仅需两小时的任务特定带动作标注演示即可达到77.5%的成功率。

title: MOSAIC: Modular Obstacle and Spatial-Aware Framework for Manipulation In Cluttered Scenes
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in robotic manipulation, yet most rely primarily on 2D visual observations and language instructions, leaving scene geometry and obstacle relationships to be inferred implicitly. This limitation is particularly problematic in cluttered environments, where small spatial errors can lead to unintended contacts or collisions. We propose MOSAIC, a modular spatial- and obstacle-aware framework that can be integrated with pretrained VLA policies to improve object-level scene understanding and action generation. Our method augments the VLA backbone with an auxiliary semantic grounding task that predicts role-specific masks for the target object, destination region, and surrounding obstacles. We further combine the target and destination masks with depth estimated from 3D scene reconstruction to construct role-specific geometric tokens that are injected directly into the action expert. In addition, we propose obstacle-aware attention supervision that emphasizes obstacles near the robot body during task execution. The resulting attention features are subsequently injected into later action-expert layers to further guide action generation. Together, these components provide explicit semantic, geometric, and obstacle-aware cues while preserving the underlying pretrained VLA architecture. We evaluate our framework on pretrained VLA model using the RoboPRO benchmark, including visual perturbation tests, and further validate it on real-world manipulation tasks. MOSAIC improves the success rate by 5.1% in cluttered scenes, and by 9.7% under visual perturbations, with gains of up to 25.0% in the most challenging environment. We will release our code and dataset upon acceptance at the following Github page: https://mmahdavian.github.io/MOSAIC/
tldr: MOSAIC is a modular framework that integrates semantic, geometric, and obstacle-aware cues into pretrained VLA policies to improve manipulation in cluttered scenes, achieving significant success rate gains on the RoboPRO benchmark and real-world tasks.
tldr_zh: MOSAIC是一个模块化框架，将语义、几何和障碍物感知线索集成到预训练的VLA策略中，以改善杂乱场景中的操作，在RoboPRO基准和真实任务中取得了显著的成功率提升。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在机器人操作任务中展现了强大的性能，但大多数模型主要依赖二维视觉观测和语言指令，场景几何结构及障碍物关系则隐含推断。这一局限在杂乱环境中尤为突出，因为细微的空间误差可能导致意外接触或碰撞。我们提出MOSAIC，一种模块化的空间与障碍物感知框架，可与预训练的VLA策略相集成，以提升对象级场景理解与动作生成能力。该方法通过辅助语义定位任务增强VLA主干网络，预测目标物体、目标区域及周围障碍物的角色特定掩码。进一步地，我们将目标掩码与目标区域掩码结合由三维场景重建得到的深度信息，构建角色特定的几何令牌，并直接注入动作专家模块。此外，我们提出障碍物感知注意力监督机制，在任务执行过程中强调机器人本体附近的障碍物。生成的注意力特征随后注入后续动作专家层，以进一步引导动作生成。综合而言，这些组件提供了显式的语义、几何及障碍物感知线索，同时保持预训练VLA架构不变。我们在RoboPRO基准上对预训练VLA模型进行了评估，包括视觉扰动测试，并在真实世界操作任务中进一步验证。MOSAIC在杂乱场景中成功率提升了5.1%，在视觉扰动下提升了9.7%，在最具挑战性的环境中最高提升达25.0%。论文录用后，我们将于以下GitHub页面发布代码和数据集：https://mmahdavian.github.io/MOSAIC/

title: RUMI: A Robotiq-Matched Universal Manipulation Interface for Robot Learning with Augmented Reality and Haptic Feedback
summary: Many manipulation tasks require carefully controlled contact forces for successful execution, yet large-scale, force-aware datasets remain scarce. Handheld interfaces can help by transmitting interaction forces directly through the operator's arm, but most existing designs are tailored to simple linear grippers and do not match the nonlinear mechanics of widely used robotic grippers. We present RUMI, a handheld universal manipulation interface matched to the Robotiq 2F-85 with exchangeable fingertip sensors that preserves the target gripper geometry while enabling natural input before contact and force measurement after contact. By integrating the tracking system into a virtual reality headset, our method provides real-time augmented reality feedback about the kinematic feasibility of motion on the target robot platform. We further introduce a haptic feedback mechanism that supports force-aware teleoperation for simulated and real robots. A user study shows fewer episodes containing joint-limit violations with live robot visualization and pose initialization (3/50) than without augmented reality (16/50). We additionally train imitation policies from demonstrations, collected using two different fingertip modalities enabled by the gripper-matched hardware, and assess the haptic interface's capability for collecting force-aware teleoperation datasets in simulation.
tldr: RUMI presents a handheld manipulation interface matched to the Robotiq 2F-85 gripper, integrating augmented reality and haptic feedback to improve teleoperation and collect force-aware demonstrations for imitation learning.
tldr_zh: RUMI 提出了一种与 Robotiq 2F-85 夹爪匹配的手持式操作界面，集成了增强现实和触觉反馈，以改进遥操作并收集力感知演示数据用于模仿学习。
summary_zh: 许多操控任务需要精细控制接触力才能成功执行，然而大规模、具备力感知的数据集仍然稀缺。手持式接口可以通过操作员的手臂直接传递交互力来提供帮助，但现有的大多数设计都针对简单的线性夹爪，无法匹配广泛使用的机器人夹爪的非线性力学特性。我们提出了RUMI，一种与Robotiq 2F-85匹配的手持式通用操控接口，配有可更换的指尖传感器，在保留目标夹爪几何结构的同时，实现了接触前的自然输入和接触后的力测量。通过将跟踪系统集成到虚拟现实头显中，我们的方法能够实时提供增强现实反馈，显示目标机器人平台上运动的运动学可行性。我们进一步引入了一种触觉反馈机制，支持对仿真和真实机器人进行力感知遥操作。用户研究表明，带有实时机器人可视化和位姿初始化的场景中，包含关节极限违反的回合数（3/50）显著少于无增强现实的场景（16/50）。此外，我们利用夹爪匹配硬件所支持的两种不同指尖模态收集演示数据，训练模仿策略，并评估该触觉接口在仿真中收集力感知遥操作数据集的能力。

title: From Foundation VLM to Versatile Driving VLM: A Triplet Incremental Training Approach
summary: Adapting general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to Autonomous Driving (AD) is thought to require heavy 3D spatial priors or intrusive architectural overhauls to compensate for a lack of spatial grounding. In this work, we present a counterintuitive pilot study: off-the-shelf general VLMs already exhibit remarkable adaptability across diverse driving tasks, while precise metric depth remains the primary missing link, a bottleneck readily addressable via onboard sensors and depth foundation models. To this end, we introduce the Triplet Incremental Training Framework, a non-intrusive paradigm that seamlessly instills 3D geometric awareness into a general VLM backbone while fully preserving its open-world capabilities. Driven by automatically constructed (image, depth, QA pair) triplets, our framework operates via a unified tri-stream training pipeline: an unfrozen primary VLM stream to adapt to driving tasks, an auxiliary depth stream that guides the visual backbone to implicitly imagine 3D scene geometry via explicit geometric constraints, and a frozen twin VLM stream employing logit-level KL distillation to prevent semantic drift. Crucially, the auxiliary depth branch is discarded during deployment, ensuring the enhanced geometric awareness comes with zero inference overhead. We evaluate our framework across four major benchmarks targeting four diverse capabilities spanning 3D spatial perception, driving-oriented language reasoning, end-to-end planning, and general multimodal understanding. Our approach outperforms state-of-the-art driving VLMs, rivals domain-specific expert models in 3D perception, and successfully retains its original general reasoning capabilities. This demonstrates that Triplet Incremental Training offers a unified, deployment-ready paradigm for transforming general foundation models into robust driving intelligences.
tldr: This paper proposes a Triplet Incremental Training framework that adapts general VLMs to autonomous driving by introducing 3D geometric awareness through automatically constructed image-depth-QA triplets, using a tri-stream training pipeline with a depth guidance branch and a frozen twin VLM for knowledge distillation, achieving SOTA driving performance with zero inference overhead.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种三元组增量训练框架，通过自动构建的图像-深度-问答三元组，利用三流训练管道（包括深度引导分支和冻结孪生VLM进行知识蒸馏）将通用VLM适配到自动驾驶，在不增加推理开销的情况下实现了SOTA驾驶性能。
summary_zh: 将通用视觉-语言模型（VLM）适配到自动驾驶（AD）领域，通常被认为需要依赖大量的三维空间先验或对模型架构进行侵入性重构，以弥补其空间感知能力的不足。在本研究中，我们提出了一项反直觉的初步探索：现成的通用VLM在多种驾驶任务中已展现出显著的适应性，而精确的度量深度仍是其主要短板——这一瓶颈可通过车载传感器和深度基础模型轻松解决。为此，我们引入了三元组增量训练框架，这是一种非侵入式范式，能够在不破坏通用VLM开放世界能力的前提下，无缝地向其骨干网络注入三维几何感知。该框架依托自动构建的（图像、深度、问答对）三元组，通过统一的三流训练流程运行：一个不冻结的主VLM流以适应驾驶任务，一个辅助深度流通过显式几何约束引导视觉骨干隐式地想象三维场景几何，以及一个冻结的孪生VLM流，利用logit级KL蒸馏防止语义漂移。关键的是，辅助深度分支在部署阶段被舍弃，确保增强的几何感知能力在推理时带来零额外开销。我们在四个主流基准上评估了该框架，覆盖三维空间感知、面向驾驶的语言推理、端到端规划以及通用多模态理解四类能力。我们的方法在驾驶VLM中取得了最优性能，在三维感知方面可与领域专用专家模型比肩，并成功保留了原有的通用推理能力。这表明，三元组增量训练为将通用基础模型转化为稳健的驾驶智能提供了一种统一且可直接部署的范式。

title: PhysCapBench: A Cross-Domain Benchmark for Physically Grounded Video Captioning
summary: Physical AI aims to learn transferable physical knowledge from real-world experience to understand, predict, and act in the physical world. Internet videos and embodied demonstrations provide complementary observations of motion, interaction, and state evolution. A foundational data challenge is to measure and preserve this physical information as training supervision. In video-language pretraining, captions express observed processes in language, yet a semantically correct description can omit the interactions and transitions that define those processes. Rich physical experience in video does not automatically translate into sufficient language supervision. This gap calls for a yardstick to assess annotation quality, compare captioning strategies, and guide training-data refinement. Motivated by our data construction for world-model pretraining, we introduce PhysCapBench, to our knowledge the first unified physical-caption benchmark spanning all three domains: third-person scenes, egocentric manipulation, and handheld-gripper demonstrations. It provides human-verified annotations for 1,500 video sequences and evaluates accuracy and coverage through seven physical dimensions. We examine downstream utility through video reconstruction and manipulation-policy fine-tuning. Physical captions reduce reconstruction LPIPS by 8.6-9.5% on third-person videos and 26.9-30.9% on egocentric videos relative to metadata captions. Training-instruction enrichment improves both PhysCapBench scores and policy success, including a 7.5-percentage-point gain for pi0.5 on a RoboTwin 2.0 subtask. PhysCapBench makes the physical content of language supervision inspectable and comparable, providing a cross-domain basis for its evaluation and improvement.
tldr: PhysCapBench is a new benchmark with human-verified physical captions for 1,500 videos across third-person, egocentric, and robot gripper domains, evaluating physical accuracy and coverage, and showing that physical captions improve video reconstruction and manipulation policy fine-tuning.
tldr_zh: PhysCapBench 是一个新的基准，包含跨第三人称、自我中心和机器人夹爪领域的 1,500 个视频的人工验证物理描述，评估物理准确性和覆盖度，并表明物理描述能改善视频重建和操作策略微调。
summary_zh: 物理人工智能旨在从真实世界经验中学习可迁移的物理知识，以理解、预测并在物理世界中采取行动。互联网视频和具身演示提供了对运动、交互和状态演化的互补性观察。一个基础的数据挑战是如何衡量并保留这些物理信息作为训练监督信号。在视频-语言预训练中，字幕以语言形式表达所观察到的过程，然而语义正确的描述可能遗漏定义这些过程的交互和状态转换。视频中丰富的物理经验并不会自动转化为充足的语言监督。这一差距需要一种衡量标准来评估标注质量、比较字幕生成策略并指导训练数据的优化。受我们为世界模型预训练所进行的数据构建工作的启发，我们提出了PhysCapBench，据我们所知这是首个统一覆盖三个领域的物理字幕基准：第三人称场景、第一人称操作以及手持机械臂演示。该基准为1，500个视频序列提供了人工验证的标注，并通过七个物理维度评估准确性和覆盖度。我们通过视频重建和操作策略微调来检验下游实用性。与元数据字幕相比，物理字幕在第三人称视频上将重建LPIPS降低了8.6–9.5%，在第一人称视频上降低了26.9–30.9%。训练指令的丰富化同时提升了PhysCapBench得分和策略成功率，包括在RoboTwin 2.0子任务上pi0.5取得了7.5个百分点的提升。PhysCapBench使语言监督中的物理内容变得可检查和可比较，为其评估和改进提供了跨领域的基础。

title: UAV-Flow++: A Unified Suite for Benchmarking and Learning Language-Guided UAV Flight
summary: Language-guided UAV navigation has largely focused on long-horizon route planning, leaving short-range, object-relative flight maneuvers underexplored. To address this gap, we formulate Flying-on-a-Word (Flow), a task requiring a UAV to convert concise natural-language instruction, egocentric visual observation, and current state dynamics into continuous flight actions. Flow encompasses both primitive motion commands and complex object-interactive behaviors, assessing motion intent comprehension and spatial context grounding. To enable policy learning and closed-loop evaluation, we introduce UAV-Flow, a comprehensive dataset comprising 30,692 expert-piloted real-world trajectories across eight distinct motion categories, alongside 10,109 simulation trajectories in the UAV-Flow-Sim environment equipped with task-specific completion criteria. Furthermore, we develop FlowVLA, which undergoes imitation pretraining on mixed real-sim demonstrations and online post-training via Tail-Aware GRPO (TGRPO). By leveraging group reward distributions, TGRPO effectively reinforces high-reward action sequences. Evaluated on 273 held-out UAV-Flow-Sim episodes, pretrained FlowVLA achieves a mean success rate of 75.58%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 6.72 percentage points, which TGRPO post-training further elevates to 93.16% with superior sample efficiency. Physical UAV experiments demonstrate robust execution of object-relative commands in both indoor and outdoor real-world scenes. Together, Flow establishes a novel benchmark and learning framework for language-conditioned flight maneuvers.
tldr: This paper introduces UAV-Flow++, a benchmark and learning suite for language-guided UAV flight, featuring a large real-world dataset, a simulation environment, and a VLA policy (FlowVLA) with a novel Tail-Aware GRPO training method, achieving strong success rates in both simulation and physical experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了UAV-Flow++，一个用于语言引导无人机飞行的基准测试和学习套件，包含大规模真实世界数据集、模拟环境和采用新型尾部感知GRPO训练方法的VLA策略（FlowVLA），在仿真和物理实验中均取得了优异的成功率。
summary_zh: 语言引导的无人机导航主要聚焦于长时程路线规划，而短距离、目标相对性的飞行机动仍未得到充分探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了“词上飞行”（Flying-on-a-Word, Flow）任务，要求无人机将简洁的自然语言指令、第一人称视觉观察以及当前状态动态转化为连续的飞行动作。Flow涵盖了基本运动指令和复杂的目标交互行为，评估运动意图理解与空间情境锚定能力。为支持策略学习与闭环评估，我们构建了UAV-Flow数据集，包含30,692条由专家操控的真实世界轨迹，覆盖八种不同运动类别，并在配备任务专属完成标准的UAV-Flow-Sim仿真环境中提供10,109条仿真轨迹。此外，我们开发了FlowVLA模型，在混合真实与仿真演示数据上进行模仿预训练，并通过尾部感知组相对策略优化（Tail-Aware GRPO，TGRPO）进行在线后训练。TGRPO利用组奖励分布，有效强化高奖励动作序列。在273个保留的UAV-Flow-Sim测试回合中，预训练的FlowVLA取得了75.58%的平均成功率，较最强基线提升6.72个百分点；经TGRPO后训练后，成功率进一步提升至93.16%，且样本效率显著更优。物理无人机实验证明，该模型在室内外真实场景中均能稳健执行目标相对性指令。综上，Flow为语言条件飞行机动建立了一个全新的基准与学习框架。

title: XBot-Omni: An Omni-Modal Model for Embodied Understanding and Interaction
summary: Embodied interaction requires an agent to integrate multimodal perception with verbal and nonverbal behaviors to effectively communicate its intentions, including speech, body motion, and facial expressions. We present XBot-Omni, a Thinker--Talker--Actor architecture that extends the Omni paradigm to robotic modalities, including body motion and facial expressions, with ``X'' representing the extensibility to robotic-specific modalities. The Thinker processes text, images, audio, and video to formulate contextually appropriate responses, which are then realized by the Talker and Actor through speech and coordinated bodily expressions, respectively. In this report, we innovatively introduce the concept of ``Actor'' as a dedicated component for embodied agents: a coordinated, streaming module that leverages the native representations of the Thinker and Talker within an end-to-end pipeline, introducing only modest latency overhead. This unified architecture enables multimodal generation conditioned on omni-modal inputs directly to prevent information loss in staged designs. We comprehensively evaluate XBot-Omni across seven benchmarks, demonstrating strong multimodal understanding capabilities on both general-domain and robot-centric videos, as well as high-quality, natural, and well-coordinated motion generation. Furthermore, our results validate its capability to generate embodied multimodal responses directly from omni inputs, meeting the diverse requirements of embodied interaction. XBot-Omni enables robots not only to perceive the omni world but also to express themselves through speech and bodily behaviors, extending Omni models from conversational interaction to embodied communication in physical environments.
tldr: XBot-Omni extends Omni models to embodied interaction by introducing a Thinker-Talker-Actor architecture that generates coordinated speech, body motion, and facial expressions from multimodal inputs, evaluated on general and robot-centric benchmarks.
tldr_zh: XBot-Omni 通过Thinker-Talker-Actor架构将全模态模型扩展到具身交互，从多模态输入生成协调的语音、身体动作和面部表情，并在通用和机器人中心基准上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 具身交互要求智能体将多模态感知与言语和非言语行为相整合，以有效传达其意图，包括语音、身体动作和面部表情。我们提出XBot-Omni，一种Thinker-Talker-Actor架构，将Omni范式扩展至机器人模态，包括身体动作和面部表情，其中“X”代表对机器人特定模态的可扩展性。Thinker处理文本、图像、音频和视频，以制定上下文适配的响应，随后由Talker和Actor分别通过语音和协调的身体表达加以实现。在本报告中，我们创新性地引入了“Actor”概念，作为具身智能体的专用组件：一个协调的流式模块，在端到端流水线中利用Thinker和Talker的原生表示，仅引入适度的延迟开销。这一统一架构支持基于全模态输入直接进行多模态生成，以避免分阶段设计中的信息损失。我们在七个基准上对XBot-Omni进行了全面评估，展示了其在通用领域和以机器人为中心的视频上的强大多模态理解能力，以及高质量、自然且协调良好的动作生成能力。此外，我们的结果验证了其直接从全模态输入生成具身多模态响应的能力，满足具身交互的多样化需求。XBot-Omni使机器人不仅能够感知全模态世界，还能通过语音和身体行为表达自身，将Omni模型从对话交互扩展至物理环境中的具身沟通。

title: Inner Product Regularization for Imitation Learning
summary: Robots that learn from demonstrations should extrapolate their policy despite state perturbations such as sensor noise, scene variation, and compounding errors. One approach to this robustness is regularization. Prior regularizers consider each state on its own and limit how sensitive the policy is to any perturbation at that state. By contrast, we explore how the policy's output shifts when given the same perturbation at different states. Our insight is that, locally, the robot should respond to state perturbations in a consistent manner: e.g., if changing an irrelevant object position does not impact the policy at one state, that same change should not shift the policy output at a nearby state. Applying this insight, we develop inner product regularization (InneR). We show that the inner product on action space induces an inner product on state space through the policy Jacobian (the Fisher information for stochastic policies), and that the null space of this inner product governs which state perturbations have a first-order effect on the policy. By clustering states whose inner products are aligned, averaging the inner products within each cluster, and minimizing the smallest eigenvalues of that average, InneR shapes the learned policy so that nearby states share a common null space. InneR enforces consistent responses to perturbations without limiting policy expressiveness, and can be appended to existing imitation learning pipelines for deterministic or stochastic policies. In simulated experiments, InneR makes learned policies more robust to irrelevant state dimensions and shifts between training and test distributions, whereas norm penalties often perform worse than behavior cloning. On a real robot arm performing three manipulation tasks, InneR raises the average success rate of a diffusion policy from 18% to 57% without additional data.
tldr: This paper introduces Inner Product Regularization (InneR), a novel regularization technique for imitation learning that encourages policies to respond consistently to state perturbations across nearby states, improving robustness and real-robot manipulation success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出内积正则化（InneR），一种用于模仿学习的新型正则化技术，通过鼓励策略在相近状态下对扰动作出一致响应，提升鲁棒性并在真实机器人操作任务中提高成功率。
summary_zh: 从示范中学习的机器人应当能够在其策略中实现外推，即使面临传感器噪声、场景变化和复合误差等状态扰动。实现这种鲁棒性的一种途径是正则化。现有的正则化方法独立地对待每个状态，并限制策略在该状态下对任何扰动的敏感程度。相比之下，我们探讨的是在不同状态下施加相同扰动时，策略输出的变化情况。我们的核心见解是，在局部范围内，机器人应当以一致的方式响应状态扰动：例如，如果在某个状态下改变一个无关物体的位置不会影响策略，那么同样的改变也不应导致邻近状态下策略输出的偏移。基于这一见解，我们提出了内积正则化方法（InneR）。我们证明了动作空间上的内积通过策略雅可比矩阵（对于随机策略而言即Fisher信息）诱导出状态空间上的内积，并且该内积的零空间决定了哪些状态扰动会对策略产生一阶影响。通过将内积对齐的状态进行聚类、对每个聚类内的内积取平均，并最小化该平均值的最小特征值，InneR塑造了所学策略，使得邻近状态共享一个共同的零空间。InneR在不限制策略表达能力的前提下，强化了对扰动的一致响应，并且可以附加到现有的模仿学习流程中，适用于确定性或随机策略。在模拟实验中，InneR使所学策略对无关状态维度以及训练与测试分布之间的偏移更加鲁棒，而范数惩罚的表现往往不如行为克隆。在一台真实机器人手臂执行三项操作任务时，InneR在无需额外数据的情况下，将扩散策略的平均成功率从18%提升至57%。

title: Safe and Efficient Navigation Considering Texting Pedestrians via Attention-Aware Cost-map Tuning
summary: Smartphone-distracted pedestrians deviate from social norms unpredictably and cannot be relied upon to yield to approaching robots -- a safety challenge that existing navigation methods are poorly equipped to handle, since they treat all pedestrians uniformly regardless of attention state. We propose an attention-aware navigation framework that classifies each pedestrian as attentive or distracted in real-time using 3D skeletal features and a Random Forest classifier, then dynamically widens cost-map safety margins around distracted individuals to drive proactive avoidance. A within-subjects user study with 12 participants across 252 trials demonstrates significant improvements in perceived smoothness (p = 0.003) and predictability (p = 0.034) over both a LiDAR-only baseline and a trajectory-prediction-only method, without any increase in travel time. Notably, trajectory prediction alone does not improve subjective navigation quality unless coupled with attention-state-aware cost adjustment -- confirming that appropriately responding to who is in front of the robot can matter more than trajectory smoothness alone.
tldr: This paper proposes an attention-aware navigation framework that classifies pedestrians as attentive or distracted using 3D skeletal features and a Random Forest classifier, then dynamically widens cost-map safety margins around distracted pedestrians to improve proactive avoidance. A user study with 12 participants shows significant improvements in perceived smoothness and predictability over baselines without increasing travel time.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种注意力感知导航框架，利用3D骨骼特征和随机森林分类器实时区分行人是否分心，并动态扩大分心行人周围成本图的安全边际以实现主动避让。12名参与者的用户研究表明，在不增加旅行时间的情况下，感知平滑性和可预测性显著优于基线。
summary_zh: 手机分心的行人会以不可预测的方式偏离社会规范，且无法可靠地期待其为接近的机器人让行——这是一个现有导航方法难以应对的安全挑战，因为这些方法将所有行人一律同等对待，而不考虑其注意力状态。我们提出了一种注意力感知的导航框架，该框架利用三维骨骼特征和随机森林分类器实时将每位行人分类为专注或分心状态，并在此基础上动态扩大分心个体周围代价地图的安全余量，以驱动主动避让。一项包含12名参与者、共252次试验的受试者内研究显示，该方法在感知流畅性（p = 0.003）和可预测性（p = 0.034）方面相较于仅依赖激光雷达的基线和仅依赖轨迹预测的方法均有显著提升，且未增加行程时间。值得注意的是，单独的轨迹预测并不能提升主观导航质量，除非与注意力状态感知的代价调整相结合——这证实了恰当应对机器人前方的行人是谁，可能比单纯的轨迹平滑更为重要。

title: NSDL: Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor for Multi-Robot Task Planning
summary: Planning for a heterogeneous robot team from a scene image and an instruction involves two kinds of decisions. Some must be judged from the scene: which goals are already met, how the task splits, and which robot does what. Others follow from these and can be computed: prerequisite actions, handoffs between robots, and timing. We argue that each kind should go to the component suited to it: a small vision-language model learns the first, and a deterministic solver computes the second. In NSDL (Neuro-Symbolic Division of Labor), the trained model writes its judgments as a plan sketch, which lists the goals that still need action and the intended steps in order, each with a robot. The solver expands the sketch into an executable joint plan. The model calls two tools, a detector for evidence and the solver, and is trained with the solver in the loop. We evaluate on the public VIKI-L2 benchmark and on LOCUS-Bench, a new benchmark that grades the two kinds of difficulty separately. NSDL outperforms end-to-end planners and formalize-then-plan baselines on both benchmarks and with three backbones from 3B to 8B; the 7B model reaches 97.0% out-of-distribution accuracy on VIKI-L2. Ordering and scheduling errors nearly disappear once the solver writes the structure; the remaining failures are misjudged states, and most goals the model misses are ones it never lists. Code, model weights, and LOCUS-Bench are publicly available at https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL.
tldr: NSDL combines a small vision-language model for scene-based task decomposition with a deterministic solver for plan expansion, achieving state-of-the-art multi-robot task planning accuracy on VIKI-L2 and LOCUS-Bench.
tldr_zh: NSDL 将小型视觉语言模型用于基于场景的任务分解，并借助确定性求解器进行计划扩展，在 VIKI-L2 和 LOCUS-Bench 上实现了最先进的多机器人任务规划精度。
summary_zh: 规划异构机器人团队从场景图像和指令出发涉及两类决策。有些决策必须基于场景进行判断：哪些目标已经达成、任务如何拆分、以及哪台机器人负责哪项工作。其他决策则由此衍生并可计算得出：前置动作、机器人之间的交接以及时序安排。我们认为，每一类决策都应交给适合它的组件处理：一个小型视觉语言模型学习第一类决策，而一个确定性求解器计算第二类决策。在NSDL（神经符号分工）中，训练后的模型将其判断写为计划草图，该草图列出仍需行动的目标以及按顺序排列的预期步骤，每一步均指定机器人。求解器将草图扩展为可执行的联合计划。该模型调用两个工具——证据检测器和求解器，并在求解器参与循环的条件下进行训练。我们在公开的VIKI-L2基准测试以及LOCUS-Bench（一个分别评估两类难度的新基准）上进行了评估。NSDL在两个基准测试中均优于端到端规划器和先形式化后规划基线，且在使用3B至8B的三种骨干模型时均表现更优；其中7B模型在VIKI-L2上实现了97.0%的分布外准确率。一旦由求解器构建结构，排序和调度错误几乎消失；剩余的失败源于状态误判，而模型遗漏的大多数目标都是其从未列出的目标。代码、模型权重和LOCUS-Bench已在 https://github.com/Xincheng-Tan/NSDL 公开提供。

title: Input-output characterization of robotic grasping: Connecting design parameters to grasp behavior through the admittance
summary: Low-impedance grippers make the dynamics of a grasp matter. Current grasp metrics, however, are static: they describe how a held object resists constant loads, not how it responds to time-varying ones. To quantify this, we rely on small-signal analysis to characterize a grasp by its admittance, the transfer matrix relating load perturbations to object displacements around an equilibrium. This transfer matrix recovers the stiffness and stability of the grasp at zero frequency and captures its natural frequencies and peak gain under time-varying loads. We apply this characterization to a planar two-finger gripper under proportional-derivative control. We show that two grasps of the same object in the same position and with the same contact forces can differ in stiffness by two orders of magnitude. Likewise, two grasps that share the same stiffness can exhibit very different resonances. Nonlinear simulations confirm the effectiveness of our small-signal analysis in capturing the dynamic behavior of grasping.
tldr: This paper introduces an admittance-based, small-signal characterization of robotic grasping dynamics, showing that static grasp metrics miss large variations in stiffness and resonance under dynamic loads.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于导纳和小信号分析的机器人抓取动力学表征方法，证明静态抓取指标无法捕捉动态载荷下刚度和谐振的巨大差异。
summary_zh: 低阻抗夹持器使得抓取动力学特性变得至关重要。然而，现有的抓取度量指标是静态的：它们描述的是被夹持物体如何抵抗恒定载荷，而非其如何响应时变载荷。为量化这一特性，我们借助小信号分析，通过导纳来表征抓取，导纳是联系平衡点附近载荷扰动与物体位移的传递矩阵。该传递矩阵在零频率下还原抓取的刚度与稳定性，并捕获其在时变载荷下的固有频率与峰值增益。我们将此表征方法应用于平面两指夹持器，并采用比例-微分控制。研究表明，对同一物体、同一位置且接触力相同的两种抓取，其刚度差异可达两个数量级。同样，刚度相同的两种抓取也可能表现出截然不同的共振特性。非线性仿真验证了我们的线性小信号分析在捕获抓取动态行为方面的有效性。

title: VOKE: Visual Object Kinematics Estimator for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
summary: Vision-based dexterous in-hand manipulation requires knowing not only where an object is, but also how it moves. However, most robotic manipulation systems rely on off-the-shelf visual perception models whose outputs are limited to static object masks, geometry, or 6D poses, leaving downstream controllers to infer object dynamics implicitly from noisy visual observations. We present VOKE, a kinematics-aware perception framework that augments existing object and hand-object pose estimators to recover a complete object kinematic state comprising pose, linear and angular velocity, and linear and angular acceleration. VOKE contains two core perception modules and a downstream application study. First, a Pluggable Kinematics Module (PKM) attaches to the output of a standard pose estimator and predicts the object's linear and angular velocity and acceleration from temporal visual features. Second, a Kinematics-guided Pose Refinement Module (KPRM) converts this motion vector into a second-order, motion-prior reference pose and refines the per-frame pose estimates. We evaluate VOKE on DexYCB and OakInk, where it consistently improves object pose estimation across three different backbones and substantially reduces velocity and acceleration estimation error compared with pose differencing. As a downstream application, we use Kinematics-Augmented Reinforcement Learning (KARL) to compare a kinematics-augmented policy with a pose-history baseline. After training the policies in simulation, we transfer the kinematics-augmented policy to the physical robot without policy fine-tuning, demonstrating the complete perception-to-control pathway in the target domain.
tldr: VOKE enhances robotic perception by estimating complete object kinematics (velocity, acceleration) from vision, and demonstrates improved pose estimation and successful sim-to-real transfer for dexterous in-hand manipulation.
tldr_zh: VOKE 通过视觉估计物体的完整运动学状态（速度、加速度），提高了姿态估计精度，并展示了在灵巧手内操作中的仿真到现实迁移能力。
summary_zh: 基于视觉的灵巧手内操作不仅需要知道物体在哪里，还需要知道它如何运动。然而，大多数机器人操作系统依赖于现成的视觉感知模型，其输出仅限于静态物体掩码、几何结构或六自由度位姿，这使得下游控制器被迫从噪声视觉观测中隐式推断物体动态。我们提出了VOKE，一个运动学感知框架，增强现有的物体和手-物位姿估计器，以恢复完整的物体运动学状态，包括位姿、线速度和角速度以及线加速度和角加速度。VOKE包含两个核心感知模块和一个下游应用研究。首先，可插拔运动学模块（PKM）连接到标准位姿估计器的输出端，从时间视觉特征中预测物体的线速度和角速度以及线加速度和角加速度。其次，运动学引导的位姿精化模块（KPRM）将这一运动向量转换为二阶运动先验参考位姿，并精化逐帧位姿估计。我们在DexYCB和OakInk数据集上评估VOKE，它在三个不同骨干网络上持续改善物体位姿估计，并且相比位姿差分方法显著减少了速度和加速度估计误差。作为下游应用，我们使用运动学增强强化学习（KARL）比较了运动学增强策略与位姿历史基线策略。在仿真中训练策略后，我们将运动学增强策略迁移到物理机器人上，无需策略微调，从而展示了目标域中从感知到控制的完整通路。

title: Memory-Efficient Parallel Policy Learning for Collapse-Reactive Retreat via Hybrid Terrain Modeling
summary: At disaster sites and on unstable slopes, robot contact can collapse uninspected terrain, requiring retreat upon support loss. Massively parallel reinforcement learning of collapse-reactive retreat requires independent state--action experiences. However, on shared rigid-body collapsible terrain, one robot's collapse alters others' contacts without direct interaction. We call this indirect interference. Duplicating terrain objects prevents this but is memory-intensive, limiting parallel sampling. Our key insight is that policy learning does not necessarily require rigid-body collapse modeling, which is feasible but computationally expensive; collapse-induced contact responses can suffice. We therefore propose a memory-efficient parallel policy-learning framework for collapse-reactive retreat via hybrid terrain modeling. Hybrid terrain modeling combines rigid-body simulation of non-collapsible terrain with virtual contact forces for collapsible regions. A State-Multiplexed Contact Model shares terrain geometry and a contact-response law while maintaining environment-specific collapse states, enabling independent experiences without terrain objects for collapsible regions. The framework trains a proprioceptive policy for both normal locomotion and collapse-reactive retreat. It supports over 100 times as many parallel environments as fine-resolution rigid-block terrain within the same GPU memory limit. This scalability and improved sample efficiency enable over 50 times faster policy convergence with comparable retreat performance. Sim-to-sim and real-robot experiments demonstrate retreat under multiple collapse conditions. A supplementary video is available at: https://youtu.be/_RrhwjzEPE0
tldr: This paper presents a memory-efficient parallel reinforcement learning framework for collapse-reactive retreat on hybrid terrain, using virtual contact forces for collapsible regions to enable massive parallelization and faster policy convergence, validated in sim-to-sim and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于坍塌反应性撤退的记忆高效并行强化学习框架，通过虚拟接触力建模可坍塌地形，实现大规模并行采样和更快的策略收敛，并在仿真和真实机器人实验中验证。
summary_zh: 在灾害现场和不稳定斜坡上，机器人接触可能导致未勘测地形坍塌，需在支撑丧失后撤退。大规模并行强化学习坍塌反应式撤退需要独立的“状态-动作”经验。然而，在共享的刚体可坍塌地形中，一个机器人的坍塌会改变其他机器人的接触状态，而无直接交互。我们将此称为间接干扰。复制地形对象可避免此问题，但内存开销大，限制了并行采样。我们的关键洞见在于，策略学习不一定需要刚体坍塌建模——该方法可行但计算代价高；坍塌引发的接触响应已足够。因此，我们提出一种基于混合地形建模的内存高效并行策略学习框架，用于坍塌反应式撤退。混合地形建模将不可坍塌地形的刚体仿真与可坍塌区域的虚拟接触力相结合。状态复用接触模型共享地形几何与接触响应规律，同时维护各环境独立的坍塌状态，从而无需为可坍塌区域复制地形对象即可获得独立经验。该框架训练一个本体感觉策略，兼顾正常行走与坍塌反应式撤退。在相同GPU内存限制下，其支持的并行环境数量是精细分辨率刚体地块地形的100倍以上。这种可扩展性与更高的样本效率使策略收敛速度提高50倍以上，且撤退性能相当。仿真到仿真及真实机器人实验验证了多种坍塌条件下的撤退能力。补充视频见：https://youtu.be/_RrhwjzEPE0

title: Hibikino-Musashi@Home 2026 Team Description Paper
summary: This paper presents an overview of the integrated technologies developed for the Open Platform League at RoboCup@Home 2026 in Incheon. A vision system integrated with learning-based, training-free models enables robust object recognition for both known and unknown objects. We introduce a RoomPlan-based method that semi-automatically registers furniture geometry and labels to generate semantic maps. Additionally, a large language model-based planner interprets the instructions recognized by Whisper and generates primitive skill sequences for execution. A reservoir-computing framework serves as a lightweight temporal-processing model for action recognition. Its field-programmable gate array-based implementation enables low-power, real-time operation. This is key to removing operational time constraints for service robots. Open-source releases, including task environments, dataset tools, and navigation frameworks, enhance reproducibility, reuse, and continuous progress within the RoboCup@Home community.
tldr: This paper describes the integrated system of the Hibikino-Musashi@Home team for RoboCup@Home 2026, featuring learning-based vision, RoomPlan-based semantic mapping, an LLM-based instruction planner, and a low-power FPGA-based reservoir computing module for action recognition, all aimed at robust and efficient service robot operation.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了 Hibikino-Musashi@Home 团队为 RoboCup@Home 2026 设计的集成系统，包括基于学习的视觉、基于 RoomPlan 的语义建图、基于大语言模型的指令规划器，以及基于 FPGA 的低功耗储备池计算动作识别模块，旨在实现稳健高效的服务机器人操作。
